real: MTU-72 / M60 AVLB armoured vehicle-launched scissor bridge (commander NSVT / M2 12.7 mm)
shape: refs: none; the old builder (mb_p27_wave1c): an AVLB / MTU-72 class bridgelayer, a tracked hull with skirts, a folded scissor bridge (two stacked span halves with rails, ribs and tread plates) on hydraulic rams, a driver hatch, a low remote weapon station on the front right; 6.45 x 3.02 x 2.02 m; team bands on both sides; no real insignia.

features.feature: the turretless T-72 class hull (Team), sloped glacis with the V splash board
the driver's hatch and periscope, lamps, hooks, front fenders
six road wheels, the rear sprocket, the front idler on its arm, a linked track
rubber side skirts with a steel top edge
engine deck grilles, the left exhaust louvre, the two fuel drums on the rear rack
the folded scissor bridge: two box treadways per half, truss sides, cross ribs, tread plates, rear hinge knuckles
the launching boom on its front pivot, two hydraulic rams and hoses
the commander's cupola with periscopes and the 12.7 mm on a raised mount (Turret), spare ammunition cans
three-tube smoke dischargers on the glacis corners
stowage boxes, a canvas bundle, tow cable, whips, tail lamps, Team bands

budget.note: heavy class: over the maximum is information only

team_zones: bands on the hull and bridge sides
wreck: the runtime breaks the tracked hull; the bridge stays on it
